suppress.notes: False positive: CPE maps Micrometer Prometheus registry to Prometheus server
False positive: CPE maps Eclipse Angus Activation to Angus Mail
Mitigated CVE-2026-47884 (XsltView SSRF/RCE): no XsltView / XSLT view resolution; controllers return JSON via @RestController only.
Mitigated CVE-2026-59313 (SSE CRLF): no WebMvc.fn / ServerResponse.sse(...); annotated @RestController / @RestControllerAdvice only.
Mitigated CVE-2026-47885 (WebFlux PartEventHttpMessageReader maxPartSize): application does not use Spring WebFlux.
Mitigated CVE-2026-47886 (SpEL power-operator DoS): application does not evaluate user-supplied SpEL expressions.
Mitigated CVE-2026-47888 (RSocket SETUP memory leak): application does not use Spring RSocket.
Mitigated CVE-2026-47889 (WebFlux Jetty cookie SameSite): no WebFlux / Jetty adapter; embedded Tomcat + Spring MVC only.
Mitigated CVE-2026-47890 (SSE + view fragments stream corruption): application does not use Server-Sent Events or view fragments.
Mitigated CVE-2026-47891 (WebFlux Aalto XML maxInMemorySize): application does not use Spring WebFlux XML parsing.
Mitigated CVE-2026-47892 (WebFlux functional endpoint header-predicate bypass): application does not use WebFlux RouterFunction / functional endpoints.
Mitigated CVE-2026-47893 (WebFlux WebSocket exception reason headers): application does not use Spring WebFlux WebSocket.
Mitigated CVE-2026-59283 (SpEL SimpleEvaluationContext compiler bypass): application does not evaluate SpEL against user-controlled expressions.

False positive / non-use CVE-2026-34479 (Log4j1XmlLayout): classpath has log4j-api via log4j-to-slf4j only; no log4j-1.2-api bridge / Log4j1XmlLayout usage. Logging is Logback + logstash-logback-encoder.
